name: Data Recipe: AI finance assistant - check incoming e-invoices

parameters.content:
## AI finance assistant: check incoming e-invoices
Drop an XRechnung XML or ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF into a Google Drive folder - or POST its URL to the webhook. Four Fast Data Actors parse it and check the supplier: [E-Invoice Parser](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/xrechnung-zugferd-einvoice-parser), [IBAN Validator](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/iban-validator-bank-lookup), [EU VAT Validator (VIES)](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/eu-vat-number-validator), [BaFin Warnings](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/bafin-investor-warnings). A traffic light (green/yellow/red) with reasons lands in Google Sheets; red invoices go to Slack.

**Setup (10 min)**
1. Create a Drive folder `Eingangsrechnungen` and share it as *Anyone with the link: Viewer* (the Actor downloads by link).
2. All four HTTP nodes: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
3. Connect Google Drive in the trigger and pick the folder; connect Google Sheets (tab `Eingangsrechnungen`) and Slack. E-mail node is optional (disabled).
4. Activate. Drive is polled every minute.

Cost per invoice: $0.003 parse + $0.0005 IBAN + $0.001 VAT + $0.01 BaFin = **$0.0145** (repeat suppliers in one run are checked once).
Technical pre-check only, not tax or legal advice.

nodes.name: Parse e-invoices
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/xrechnung-zugferd-einvoice-parser: XRechnung (UBL/CII) and ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF to JSON. One row per file; only parsed invoices are charged.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ibans: $('Collect check inputs').first().json.ibans, includeBankInfo: true }) }}

nodes.name: Check IBANs
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/iban-validator-bank-lookup: checksum, length, SEPA flag, bank name/BIC from the Bundesbank BLZ file.

nodes.name: Check VAT IDs
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/eu-vat-number-validator against the EU VIES service. Add "requesterVatNumber": "DE..." (your own VAT ID) to get a consultation number as proof.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ mode: 'screen', queries: $('Collect check inputs').first().json.names, minScore: 85, maxMatchesPerQuery: 1, includeMeasures: true }) }}

nodes.name: Screen BaFin warnings
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/bafin-investor-warnings in screen mode: fuzzy match of the seller names against current BaFin warnings and measures.

nodes.name: Send e-mail
nodes.notes: Optional: enable and add SMTP credentials to get red invoices by e-mail too.
